Q1. What is a capsule elevator?
A capsule elevator is a glass-walled lift that provides panoramic views while traveling between floors, adding style and modern appeal.
Q2. How much does a capsule elevator cost?
Costs vary based on design, size, and customization. BG Elevators provides clear, competitive quotes tailored to your project.
Q3. How long does installation take?
Installation typically takes 6–10 weeks depending on customization and building requirements.
Q4. Do capsule elevators require special maintenance?
Yes, regular maintenance ensures safety, durability, and optimal performance. BG Elevators offers AMC packages for hassle-free care.
